definitions: Relating to both the vestibule and the cochlea of the inner ear.
Pertaining to the vestibulocochlear nerve (cranial nerve VIII), which is responsible for transmitting sound and balance information from the inner ear to the brain.
examples: The vestibulocochlear nerve plays a crucial role in hearing and balance.
Damage to the vestibulocochlear system can result in dizziness and hearing loss.
